changes.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service optimised engine now publishes data to Amazon S3 Tables
changes.detail: The optimized engine for observability in Amazon OpenSearch Service now lets customers who send observability data directly to OpenSearch publish that data to Amazon S3 Tables. These customers can search and analyze data in OpenSearch, but reusing it with other analytics and AI tools often requires a parallel ingestion or custom export pipeline. This integration provides an open-table reuse path without changing how data enters OpenSearch. Publish policies make selected indexes available as Apache Iceberg tables in your AWS account. Engineers and AI agents can query the same observability data
